merged: **Domaine des Trois Chênes – Handover Summary** - **Vineyard:** 18 ha (11 ha Cabernet Franc, 7 ha Chenin Blanc) on clay‑flint soils. - **Production:** ~62 000 bottles / yr; 2024 output fell to 48 000 after May hail damaged the western plots (≈ 20 % loss, a “fifth” of the area). - **Certification:** Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion started 2023, earliest certification expected 2026. - **Exports:** 41 % of volume, mainly to Belgium and Japan (Japan limits sulphites to < 60 mg/L). - **Past issues:** * 2022 Tank 4 controller drift cost €11 000 – controllers now calibrated pre‑harvest, a second probe installed. * 2023 label‑proof error recalled 900 bottles – proofs now require two signatures. - **Operational rules:** No irrigation on western plots; harvest dates set after three consecutive mornings of sugar/acidity readings; any tank exceeding 28 °C must be cooled within four hours. - **Open items (uncertain):** Lighter‑weight
